basics.name: Filippo Sallemi
basics.label: Technical Architect · Engineering & AI Leadership
basics.summary: Technical Architect with experience as a Head of Development and Lead Developer, combining engineering leadership with hands-on expertise in AI architecture, systems integration and cloud platforms. My approach is to give teams clear technical direction, develop their judgement and distribute knowledge and responsibility so they can work autonomously. My technical experience includes AI agents, workflow automation, persistent memory, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. I have worked across iGaming and affiliate businesses, with a focus on practical outcomes, reliable systems and sustainable operating costs.

work.name: Grandstand (formerly Gambling.com Group)
highlights: AI Strategy & Adoption: Selected to contribute to a cross-functional leadership initiative shaping how agentic AI is introduced across software engineering, translating research into practical standards, tooling, and adoption patterns.

Enterprise AI Platform: Conceived an internal AI memory platform and led its initial technical development, turning the concept into a working product. Coordinated its continued development and rollout across development, delivery planning, infrastructure, testing and onboarding.
Engineering Enablement: Helped engineering teams adopt AI through practical guidance, reusable MCP integrations, shared development patterns and technical knowledge sharing.
Contributed to cloud cost optimisation through FinOps analysis and workload improvements.
Delivery Acceleration: Improved environment provisioning by architecting automated cloud deployment pipelines using AWS Fargate/ECS.
Contributed to architectural standards, Infrastructure as Code adoption with Terraform, and CI/CD practices across engineering teams.

work.name: Gambling.com Group
highlights: Led a development team spanning engineering and QA, combining people management and delivery responsibility with hands-on technical leadership.
Developed engineers through regular one-to-ones, individual development plans, actionable feedback and increasing ownership of technical decisions and delivery.
Aligned team priorities and delivery plans with product goals, balancing business commitments, technical quality and opportunities for engineers to grow.
Led a major platform upgrade while maintaining feature delivery, coordinating technical decisions, engineering practices and dependencies with other teams.

work.name: Videoslots
highlights: Contributed to the integration of the Italian ADM protocol, helping resolve an implementation that had stalled. Managed the technical work during the certification session, supporting its successful completion.
Optimised a high-volume transactional PHP/Laravel backend handling real-time gaming traffic, with a focus on data integrity, reliability, and security.

work.name: The Ear Limited
highlights: Built and developed the engineering team of an iGaming startup, reporting to the CTO and helping shape the technical roadmap and team structure.
Built a casino aggregation platform integrating third-party game providers, with a focus on performance and availability.
Led the migration of a legacy platform to a modern architecture, reducing technical debt while maintaining service continuity.
Led engineering work supporting multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements across MGA, UKGC, Italy, and Colombia.

work.name: Nomad NT
highlights: Ran a technology company, with responsibility for client acquisition and technical delivery for government and private-sector clients.
Delivered web platforms, Linux infrastructure, network security systems, and embedded automation projects across commercial and maritime environments.

work.name: Voismart SRL
highlights: Led developers building the web UI for a VoIP/PBX product, combining team leadership with work across Asterisk, SIP, and networking.

projects.name: AI-Enhanced iGaming Aggregator
projects.description: Designed and built a casino aggregator using a microservices architecture, with a back-office platform enriched by AI capabilities. Integrated a custom MCP server to connect the aggregator's data layer to LLMs, enabling natural-language querying of GGR reports, automated risk workflows, and AI-assisted business intelligence without manual SQL overhead.
